author: xabiercidvidal
body:
Split the two free functions from TrackExtenderWithMTD's anonymous namespace into proper shared headers:

  TrackingTools/PatternTools/interface/trajectoryStateClosestToBeamLine.h
    trajectoryStateClosestToBeamLine(Trajectory, BeamSpot, Propagator, &tscbl)
    -- pure tracking utility, no MTD-specific types; available to muon reco
       and any other subsystem that needs the TSCBL of a trajectory.

  RecoMTD/TimingTools/interface/TrackPathLength.h  (namespace mtd)
    trackPathLength(Trajectory, tscbl, Propagator, &pathLength, &TrackSegments)
    trackPathLength(Trajectory, BeamSpot, Propagator, &pathLength, &TrackSegments)
    -- MTD-specific overloads that fill a TrackSegments while integrating the
       path; located in RecoMTD/TimingTools because TrackSegments lives there
       and the dependency direction (RecoMTD -> TrackingTools) is correct.

TrackExtenderWithMTD.cc anonymous namespace is now empty and removed. RecoMTD/TimingTools/BuildFile.xml gains TrackingTools/PatternTools, TrackingTools/TrajectoryState and TrackingTools/GeomPropagators dependencies.

No logic changes.

Rebased onto current master (which already includes the two prior TrackExtenderWithMTD refactoring PRs, #51374 and #51550); resolved a using-declaration ordering conflict with the clang-format fix applied to TrackExtenderWithMTD.cc during #51550's review.

#### PR description:

Continues the `TrackExtenderWithMTD.cc` refactor from #51374 and #51550 (both merged). Pure code motion  no change to reconstruction output is expected. Depends on #51374 and #51550, both already merged into master.

#### PR validation:

Validated against baseline (master) using the PU200 RelVal TTbar sample (D121, Phase2C22I13M9), 900 events (9x100) each for baseline and this PR. RelMon comparison (bin-to-bin KS test, t=0.99999, MTD subdirectory only, matching the CMS PR-bot settings): 827/827 histograms passing (100%). 814 overlay canvases (baseline=black, this PR=red) additionally checked by eye for consistency.

Full RelMon report + plots: [https://cernbox.cern.ch/s/SkvqVCkfvPcOtHm](https://cernbox.cern.ch/s/SkvqVCkfvPcOtHm)

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport.
title: Extract path-length utilities from TrackExtenderWithMTD
